tasks.title: Enter the business data for the legal pages
tasks.detail: The terms and the privacy policy name your business and its address. Until you enter them, the live pages show marked gaps.

tasks.title: Register for sales tax in each state where you have a tax duty
tasks.detail: A state can require a permit when your sales or orders there pass its limit (economic nexus). Marketplaces such as eBay and Amazon collect and pay the tax on their own orders. Stripe Tax shows where you cross a limit. Enter a permit number for each state you register in.

tasks.title: Check the state notices for your products
tasks.detail: Some products need a notice in some states, for example California Proposition 65 for products with listed chemicals. Add the notice on the product page.

tasks.title: Check if the state privacy laws apply to you
tasks.detail: California and other states set limits (revenue or number of consumers) for the privacy laws. When they apply, keep the notice at collection and the opt-out of sale and sharing that the shop shows.
